posts.text:
Have you ever heard of the Swanton border sector? 

Probably not.  

But in the last three fiscal years, Swanton has seen nearly 3x the number of apprehensions (23,085) as Big Bend (9,624), according to CBP's own data.

Swanton is part of our northern border with Canada.

Yet we're being told there's a crisis in Big Bend that requires a border wall.
posts.summary: Challenges narrative that southern border is primary concern
